title: Settings
subtitle: Manage your profile, family and account.
profileDesc: Your personal information and how you appear to the family.
pendingProfileUpdate: You have a pending profile update awaiting parent approval.
profileApprovalNote: Profile changes are sent to a parent for approval before they take effect.

regenerateNote: Regenerating the invite code is not available yet. This action will invalidate the old code once enabled.
inAppDesc: Notifications appear in Queki while you are signed in.

roleCopyParent: Approval requests — tasks, reward requests, and transfers — appear in your notification center.
